parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Data Transmission Service (DTS) instance. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the ETL task. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the task ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the DTS instance resides. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the available Alibaba Cloud regions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-dts-etl-job-version-info --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --dts-instance-id dtsggk12iwya1a0000 --dts-job-id l5512es7w150000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
